title: A federated learning-based intrusion detection method for 5G smart grid
assignee: Electric Power Research Institute of State Grid Fujian Electric Power Co Ltd

pse.problem: Existing methods for intrusion detection in smart grids rely on centralized servers and may compromise user data privacy. The need for fast, secure, and efficient intrusion detection is crucial for the smart grid system.
pse.solution_function: The invention proposes a federated learning-based intrusion detection method for 5G smart grids. Smart meters cooperatively train an efficient intrusion detection model by exchanging only model parameters with a cloud server, ensuring data privacy protection and scalability.
pse.solution_structure: The system includes smart meters as local devices that collect data, exchange model parameters, and perform local inference. The cloud server receives model parameters from the smart meters for aggregation and global update of the intrusion detection model.
pse.solution_implementation: In each round of federated learning, smart meters locally train a neural network using their data, compute gradients based on the trained model, and send updated model parameters to the cloud server. The cloud server aggregates these updates to refine the global intrusion detection model.
pse.effect: The solution provides secure and efficient intrusion detection for smart grids by leveraging 5G communication technology, improving the speed and reliability of data transmission while protecting user privacy.
